info.name: (Partner-implemented) Receive a new lead notification from Thumbtack

items.docs: Implemented by the partner at the partner's own domain. Thumbtack POSTs new-lead notifications to this endpoint. Path shown is the documented relative path; the partner's base URL is registered with Thumbtack during onboarding.
